svg.title: ST185 fuse box assemblies - wiring block diagram
svg.text: (1/0 battery cable in; alternator / starter out)
POWER NEG bar: M8 ground studs
glove box, outboard - AMI fuse bar (IN row feeds the relays, OUT row feeds the cabin) - rev 7
glove box, inboard - Bus 1 / Bus 2 mini-fuse strips and 7 micro relays - rev 7
trunk, passenger side between the rear wall and the battery - fuel pump relay and its fuse (rev 7)
-> Heater relay output splice (4 AWG) - blower motor + and the ACPS fuse
-> OEM old R/B4 heater relay lead pin 1 (RH kick), L-W - A/C amp HR (EWD 1993
-> OEM old R/B4 heater relay lead pin 3 (RH kick), R-L - coil + feed (EWD 1993
-> ECU plug A pin 28 (Link ECU, center dash) - Aux 6 sinks the EFI relay coil
-> Starter solenoid S spade lug (A-engine loom) - start relay output
-> ECU plug A pin 26 (Link ECU, center dash) - Aux 8 sinks the start relay coil
-> SW12 bus plug DT06-12 (glove box, by LOGIC box) pin 6
-> Radiator fan plug pin + (loom C, front) - radiator fan +12 V, 8 AWG
-> ECU plug A pin 29 (Link ECU, center dash) - Aux 5 sinks the radiator fan relay
-> SW12 bus plug DT06-12 (glove box, by LOGIC box) pin 4
-> Condenser fan plug pin + (loom C, front) - condenser fan +12 V, 8 AWG
-> ECU plug B pin 13 (Link ECU, center dash) - Ign 5 sinks the condenser fan relay
-> SW12 bus plug DT06-12 (glove box, by LOGIC box) pin 7
-> OEM old R/B2 relay lead pin 1 (LH kick), W-G wire - power windows (EWD 1993
-> OEM old R/B2 relay lead pin 2 (LH kick), L-Y - GAUGE 15A, ignition on (EWD 1993
-> OEM cowl plug IE1 pin 3 (LH kick), W wire - RTR 30A to retract relay R8 (EWD
-> OEM cowl plug IE1 pin 10 (LH kick), W wire - AM1 to ignition switch (EWD p.31)
-> OEM cowl plug IE1 pin 17 (LH kick), B-R wire - AM2 to ignition switch (EWD
-> OEM J/B 1 plug 1I pin 1 (LH kick), B wire - J/B 1 main B+ (EWD p.18-19)
-> MR-S EHPS pump relay (HCR150, glove box, beside the POWER box) pin 30
-> Heater relay output splice (4 AWG) - blower motor + and the ACPS fuse
-> A/C pressure switch A5 pin 1 (loom C, engine bay) - switch +12 V (1990 EWD
-> Kill switch MAIN 2 stud, trunk RH rear (HeavyDC) - battery + after the switch,
-> RADLOK + stud, cabin side, RH firewall (HeavyDC) - to starter B+
-> Battery negative terminal post, trunk RH rear (HeavyDC) - battery - via H2
-> RADLOK negative stud, cabin side, RH firewall (HeavyDC) - to engine block
-> Ground stud ID, left kick panel (EWD ground point ID) - POWER box NEG strap
-> Ground bolt IG, right kick (EWD ground point IG) - POWER box NEG strap
-> Bulkhead B pin 95 (DRB102, RH firewall) - CAN-Lambda +12 V
-> SW12 bus plug DT06-12 (glove box, by LOGIC box) pin 1
-> Bulkhead A pin 2 (DRB102, RH firewall) - COP coil +12 V rail (COP 15A)
-> HAZ-HORN splice - HZ 15A fuse to the hazard feed and the horn relay
-> Bulkhead A pin 1 (DRB102, RH firewall) - injector +12 V rail (INJ 15A)
-> OEM J/B 1 plug 1H pin 2 (LH kick), L-Y wire - DOME 20A feed (EWD 1993 p.132)
-> CSB3 plug pin 1 (CSB3 box under the cluster) - CSB3 +12 V switched
-> OEM old R/B2 relay lead pin 2 (LH kick), W-L wire - door lock + tilt-away (EWD
-> Dash device +12 V splice (CAN loom) - center cluster and RealDash Pi +12 V
-> Alarm +12 V splice (AntiTheft loom, center dash) - alarm pin 1 constant +12 V
-> Shock sensor +12 V splice (AntiTheft loom, ECU area) - shock sensor pin A
-> Alternator plug G2 pin 1 (engine bay, via loom C) - S battery sense (EWD 1993
-> Alarm ignition splice (AntiTheft loom, center dash) - alarm pin 3 ignition
-> Bulkhead A pin 42 (DRB102, RH firewall) - EHPS pump logic enable (pump pin C1)
-> ECU plug B pin 30 (Link ECU, center dash) - DI 7 start request
-> OEM starter relay socket R/B4 pin 1, B-W wire - ignition ST1 start request (EWD
-> Headlight coil splice - HEAD LH and RH relay coils to cowl plug IE1 pin 2
-> LH headlight plug H1 pin 3 (loom C, LH front) - headlight LH +12 V (EWD 1993
-> Headlight coil splice - HEAD LH and RH relay coils to cowl plug IE1 pin 2
-> RH headlight plug H2 pin 3 (loom C, RH front) - headlight RH +12 V (EWD 1993
-> ECU plug A pin 20 (Link ECU, center dash) - Aux 2 sinks the ETB relay coil
-> SW12 bus plug DT06-12 (glove box, by LOGIC box) pin 5
-> ECU plug B pin 5 (Link ECU, center dash) - ETB motor supply from the ETB relay
-> GAUGE 15A splice - J/B 3 feed to reverse relay pin 30 and the back-up switch
-> Reverse switch splice (B-cabin loom) - back-up switch B1 pin 1, +12 V in
-> Back-up lamp splice (RearLights loom, rear) - R11 and R12 pin 4 back-up lamps
-> HAZ-HORN splice - HZ 15A fuse to the hazard feed and the horn relay
-> OEM cowl plug IE1 pin 19 (LH kick), G wire - horn switch line (EWD 1993 p.185)
-> HAZ-HORN splice - HZ 15A fuse to the hazard feed and the horn relay
-> Horn splice (loom C, front) - horn relay output to horns H3 and H4 pin 1
-> ECU plug B pin 10 (Link ECU, center dash) - Ign 8 sinks the A/C clutch relay
-> A/C pressure switch splice (A-cabin loom) - switch A5 pin 4 output to the
-> A/C magnet clutch A4 pin 4 (loom C, compressor) - clutch +12 V (1990 EWD p.152)
-> ECU plug B pin 12 (Link ECU, center dash) - Ign 6 sinks the EPS enable relay
-> SW12 bus plug DT06-12 (glove box, by LOGIC box) pin 9
-> ECU A pin 19 (Link ECU, center dash; A-cabin) - fuel pump relay drive
-> SW12 splice after LOGIC Bus 2 pin 2 (glove box; CabinPower) - switched 12 V
-> Fuel pump plug pin 1 (in the tank; RearFuel) - pump +12 V
one wire, drawn in its insulation colour; the label is "wire id | gauge | colour (ident bands)"
A line that crosses another with a gap does not connect to it. A dot is a pin or stud. The brown bar is a copper bus bar / strip.
A wire that leaves the assembly ends at the stub; the text after "->" is where that far end lands (DECISIONS R156). Overhead block view, not to scale.
Rows are grouped for readable wires, not in physical order: every fuse and relay carries its cavity number (BUS1-n, BUS2-n, AMI IN-n, AMI OUT-n).
ST185 FUSE BOX ASSEMBLIES - WIRING BLOCK DIAGRAM
POWER box + LOGIC box (glove box) and battery relay block (trunk). Sources: sot/channels.csv, cad/fusebox/src/spec.py, docs/harness/interfaces.json.
